text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On a day off. I came to the mountains for 
a hike to take a breather, but—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Hum-hum-hum♪ Treasure, o treasure~~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Told that "there's something great to 
unwind with," I joined her in searching 
for treasure.
choice_data_list:
I wonder if there really is treasure out 
there?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Or so the rumors say! Why don't we go see 
for ourselves? Here we go!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
――OK! I checked our current location via 
GPS. Looks like we're heading in the right 
direction. And also……

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
It looks gloomy ahead. Here, take a spare 
glowstick.
choice_data_list: You seem pretty used to this.
You seem pretty used to this.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, well of course. I search every 
single time I catch wind of treasure.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
You'll never know if it's there until you 
check. Which means—the odds aren't zero!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Striking it rich with undiscovered 
treasure! How could anyone resist chasing 
a romantic dream like that?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tap Dance City spoke with sparkling eyes. 
Watching her, a burning passion welled up 
inside me.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
According to the intel, the treasure's 
atop this cliff. Hmm…… climbing this is 
going to be quite a chore.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Plus, there's no guarantee treasure 
awaits, even if you risk your life 
climbing.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Now then, what'll it be?
choice_data_list:
Whatever lies beyond this――I want to see 
it too.

Whatever lies beyond this――I want to see 
it too.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Now then, what'll it be?
choice_data_list:
Whatever lies beyond this――I want to see 
it too.

Whatever lies beyond this――I want to see 
it too.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Good! I had a feeling you'd say that!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Let's climb the cliff! Let's chase after 
romance together!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After somehow managing to climb the cliff 
together, we split up to search for the 
treasure. And the result was――

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Whew~~♪ You've got quite the cool 
expression on your face right now, you 
know?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll climb up first and secure the 
route. You follow behind me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Once both of us managed to scramble up the 
cliff, we split up to search for the 
treasure. And the result was――

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Nothing? No reaction from the metal 
detector at all! There's no sign anything 
was buried here, either.
choice_data_list:
Doesn't look like there's any treasure 
here...

Doesn't look like there's any treasure 
here...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looks like this one was a dud. Still――all 
that's left is to chase the next romantic 
dream.
choice_data_list: The chances aren't zero, after all!
The chances aren't zero, after all!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Never give up! I'll definitely find 
it next time!
